title: Medical Certificates & Sick Leave: Orvosi igazolás & Táppénz

sections.content:
When unable to work or attend school due to illness:
- **Orvosi igazolás** = Doctor's medical certificate
- **Betegszabadság** = Sick leave (first 15 working days paid by employer at 70%)
- **Táppénz** = Sickness benefit paid by health insurance after 15 days
- You must contact your GP on the first day of illness (*be kell jelenteni az első napon*).
- *Kérem az orvosi igazolást a munkahelyemre.* (I request the medical certificate for my workplace.)

items.spanish: A háziorvos kiállította az orvosi igazolást a munkahelyemre.
items.english: The GP issued the medical certificate for my workplace.

items.spanish: Három napig betegszabadságon voltam influenzás tünetek miatt.
items.english: I was on sick leave for three days due to flu symptoms.

items.spanish: Mielőtt visszatér a munkába, orvosi ellenőrzésre kell mennie.
items.english: Before returning to work, you must go for a medical check-up.
